description: This Scala source file contains utility functions and data structures for stratified sampling in Apache Spark, including exact sample size computation, acceptance and waitlist management, and sampling functions for with and without replacement scenarios.

classes.name: AcceptanceResult
classes.description: Tracks the number of items accepted, waitlisted, and total items per stratum, along with bounds for acceptance and waitlisting.

classes.name: RandomDataGenerator
classes.description: Generates uniform and Poisson random numbers, with caching for Poisson distributions.

methods.name: getAcceptanceResults
methods.description: Counts accepted items and generates waitlists for each stratum when exact sampling is needed.

methods.name: getSeqOp
methods.description: Creates a function to collect sampling statistics per partition, updating acceptance and waitlist info.

methods.name: getCombOp
methods.description: Combines sampling results from different partitions.

methods.name: computeThresholdByKey
methods.description: Calculates acceptance thresholds for each stratum to achieve exact sample sizes.

methods.name: getBernoulliSamplingFunction
methods.description: Provides sampling function for Bernoulli (without replacement) sampling, with optional exact size guarantee.

methods.name: getPoissonSamplingFunction
methods.description: Provides sampling function for Poisson (with replacement) sampling, with optional exact size guarantee.
